contexts.text: He puts off the old man...
He makes his old man new.
The old man is in the affections of worldly and earthly things... The old man regards ends in the world.
In order that man may be led from the state of the old man... AC 4067:4.
Jehovah appeared to Moses as an aged and bearded man... Hence the Jews (thought) of Jehovah as a very aged man...
When the old man dies...
He would put off the old man, that is, the loves of self and of the world with their concupiscences...
It is known... that the old man is to be put off...
The old Natural... must become as nothing...

As a lion, and as an old lion () = the good of love and the derivative truth in their power... An old lion = him who is in power through good; for those who are in celestial good never fight, but are safe through good... These are they who are signified by an old lion.
Regeneration takes place to the end that the life of the old man may die...
The knowledge and wisdom of the ancients...
This is meant by the old man dying with his concupiscences...
(Those of the Fourth Earth) want to appear old; for the reason that they always choose some bearded old man, who is as it were their king and chief priest...
From the writings of the most ancients in Greece.
Their wounds are inveterate.
Disusage makes a man old.
If he does not rise as to the will also, he is still the old man...
An old man seen (who is adored by them.) SE 3281. SE 4880.
Concerning... the destruction of the old Heaven and earth.
Old wine () = the truth of the old, or Jewish, Church... Old bottles = the statutes and judgments of the Jewish Church.

That those who have been born and educated in the external things which were of the Jewish Church cannot be at once brought into the internal things which are of the Christian Church, is signified by, no one drinking old wine straightway wants new, for he says, The old is more useful.

The old cast clouts and rotten rags () with which they drew out Jeremiah, = the vindication of the truth of doctrine and the restitution thereof by means of such goods and truths of the sense of the letter of the Word as have not been perceived and understood, and have therefore been neglected and rejected. These are signified by those old things.
The garment which waxes old () = truth destroyed through the falsities of evil.
Thy raiment waxed not old... () = that the natural man has not been injured through these afflictions.
